content.user_title: Plan AI and ML Development Workflows
content.value_statement: AI projects often span model selection, RAG, agents, pipelines, and monitoring. This workflow organizes those phases into clear steps and related specialist skills.
actual_capabilities: Guides AI application design from use case definition to architecture planning.
Lists specialist skills for LLM integration, RAG, agents, MLOps, and observability.
Provides copy-paste prompts for invoking related AI development skills.
Supplies checklists for LLM integration, RAG systems, agents, observability, and quality gates.
Highlights security, validation, monitoring, cost tracking, and documentation tasks.
limitations: Does not implement code, models, infrastructure, or data pipelines by itself.
Depends on separate specialist skills for detailed implementation guidance.
Requires project-specific validation, testing, security review, and deployment checks.
Does not replace expert review for regulated or high-risk AI systems.

use_cases.title: Launch an LLM Product
use_cases.description: Product teams can map use cases, model choices, data flows, and success metrics before implementation.

use_cases.title: Build a RAG System
use_cases.description: Engineering teams can coordinate embedding selection, vector storage, retrieval, reranking, caching, and accuracy testing.

use_cases.title: Operationalize ML Delivery
use_cases.description: MLOps teams can align pipeline design, evaluation, model registry work, observability, and quality gates.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a New AI Feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to plan an AI-powered feature. Identify the use case, model options, data flow, risks, and success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design a RAG Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to design a RAG system. Cover ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector storage, retrieval, reranking, caching, and evaluation.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Agent Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to design a multi-agent system. Define roles, tools, memory, orchestration, human review, logging, and failure handling.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Production AI Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this workflow to prepare production delivery. Review LLM integration, ML pipeline, observability, security controls, tests, and documentation.

output_examples.input: I need to add a support chatbot to a SaaS product.
output: Recommended phases: AI application design, LLM integration, RAG implementation, observability, and security review.
Next steps: define success metrics, secure API access, build retrieval, test answers, and monitor costs.

output_examples.input: Our team is selecting embeddings and a vector database.
output_examples.output: The workflow points to embedding, vector database, similarity search, and hybrid search skills. It also adds retrieval accuracy testing and caching checkpoints.

output_examples.input: We are preparing an ML model for production.
output: Recommended phases: ML pipeline development, AI observability, AI security, and quality gates.
Checks include model evaluation, registry setup, tracing, alerts, access controls, and documentation.

best_practices: Start with success metrics, data boundaries, and user safety requirements.
Use the related specialist skills when a phase requires implementation depth.
Treat checklist items as release gates, not as optional notes.
anti_patterns: Using the workflow as a substitute for testing, security review, or monitoring.
Skipping data quality, retrieval evaluation, or model performance validation.
Invoking every related skill when the task only needs one focused phase.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps plan AI and machine learning projects across design, LLM integration, RAG, agents, pipelines, observability, and security.

faq.question: Does it write production code?
faq.answer: No. It organizes the workflow and points to specialist skills for implementation guidance.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it useful for RAG projects?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes phases for embeddings, vector databases, retrieval, hybrid search, reranking, caching, and evaluation.

faq.question: Does it cover AI safety?
faq.answer: It includes security actions such as validation, output filtering, rate limits, access controls, abuse monitoring, and audit logging.

faq.question: When should I avoid it?
faq.answer: Avoid it for small tasks that only need one focused AI or data engineering skill.
